Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْئَلُكَ الْاَمَانَ يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ مَالٌ  وَلابَنُوْنَ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You for security on the Day when neither wealth nor children will benefit

Arabic text: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى اللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيْمٍ
Translation: Except for one who comes to Allah with a sound heart

Arabic text: وَأَسْئَلُكَ الْاَمَانَ يَوْمَ يَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ
Translation: And I ask You for security on the Day when the wrongdoer will bite his hands

Arabic text: يَقُوْلُ يَا لَيْتَنِيْ اتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ الرَّسُوْلِ سَبِيْلًا
Translation: Saying, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way"

Arabic text: وَأَسْئَلُكَ الْاَمَانَ يَوْمَ يُعْرَفُ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ بِسِيْمَاهُمْ
Translation: And I ask You for security on the Day when the criminals will be known by their marks
And they will be seized by their forelocks and feet

Arabic text: وَأَسْئَلُكَ الْاَمَانَ يَوْمَ لَا يَجْزِيْ وَالِدٌ عَنْ وَلَدِهِ
Translation: And I ask You for security on the Day when no father will avail his son

Arabic text: وَلَا مَوْلُوْدٌ هُوَ جَازٍ عَنْ وَالِدِهِ شَيْئًا
Translation: Nor will a son avail his father at all
Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth

Arabic text: وَأَسْئَلُكَ الْاَمَانَ يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ الظَّالِمِيْنَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ
Translation: And I ask You for security on the Day when the excuses of the wrongdoers will not benefit them
And they will have the curse and the worst home

Arabic text: وَأَسْئَلُكَ الْاَمَانَ يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِنَفْسٍ شَيْئًا
Translation: And I ask You for security on the Day when no soul will possess anything for another soul
And the command, that Day, is with Allah

Arabic text: وَأَسْئَلُكَ الْاَمَانَ يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ الْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيْهِ
Translation: And I ask You for security on the Day when a man will flee from his brother
And his mother and his father, and his wife and his children

Arabic text: لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيْهِ
Translation: Every person, that Day, will have enough concern to make him indifferent to others

Arabic text: وَأَسْئَلُكَ الْاَمَانَ يَوْمَ يَوَدُّ الْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِيْ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِبَنِيْهِ
Translation: And I ask You for security on the Day when the criminal will wish he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children
And his wife and his brother and his nearest kindred who shelter him

Arabic text: وَمَنْ فِيْ الْاَرْضِ جَمِيْعًا ثُمَّ يُنْجِيْهِ
Translation: And whoever is on earth entirely, then it could save him
